## Source and method

Every field verified against vendor primary sources (developer docs, public repos, registries) by aifitnessapi.com during 2026 and published with per-item provenance on the linked pages. Fields that could not be verified are null — never guessed. No dollar figures by design: prices are volatile; structures are stable.

A null means the source does not state the value or it could not be verified. It never means zero, and it is never a guess. In the CSV a null is an empty unquoted field.

## Update cadence

- `src/data/costModel.ts` is maintained by hand alongside the pages it feeds; this dataset is regenerated from it with `npm run datasets` in the change that edits it, so it moves when the site's pages move.
- The files are rebuilt by `npm run datasets` (scripts/build-datasets.mjs); a run with no source change writes byte-identical files. The edition stays 2026.1, and a new edition ships under a new file name rather than overwriting this one.
